annotations.title: Location data, place brief: weather, sunrise and country facts

description: One call for a place by name: its coordinates, country, region, population and elevation (Wikidata), the current weather and a short hourly forecast (MET Norway, CC BY 4.0), today's sunrise, sunset and day length, and facts about its country (capital, region, income level, population). Cheaper than the tools bought one by one. Use for travel planning, event and delivery context, or enriching a city name in a record. Example: place=Stockholm. Price $0.03/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
